featured_reviews.review_text:
Sometimes the best decisions come after a mistake.

Even though Yadnesh is my friend, I chose another photographer because of packages differences —and honestly, it didn’t go well. We faced a lot of issues and didn’t even get our photos properly.

featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Adke
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing the perfect photographer for our wedding day was a major task and concern for us. After extensive research and numerous meetings with different photographers, we finally made the decision to entrust our special day to the "Fatty's Photography" team.

We are overjoyed that we went ahead with this choice. Moments come and go, but thanks to the team, we now have incredible photos and videos that allow us to relive those precious memories.

From Haldi-Sangeet ceremony to the wedding day itself, Fatty's team was punctual, organized, and ever-smiling. Not a single member of the team was irritated or frustrated despite the usual chaos associated with Indian weddings.

Yadnesh and team, we are truly grateful for your exceptional work. Words cannot express how fortunate we feel. We've been wholeheartedly recommending Fatty's Photography to everyone
we know.

The seamless coordination within the team was remarkable, and credit goes to Rasika, who was always available to address any queries we had.

You've immortalized beautiful memories for us that we will treasure for a lifetime. A special shoutout to the multi-talented Yadnesh, the driving force behind this wonderful experience.

We extend our heartfelt best wishes to you for all your future endeavors.

To all the couples and individuals currently considering a photographer, reading this review – hesitate no more and choose Fatty's Photography. You will undoubtedly not regret it.
